name: ensoniqplaystreamstereo
description: ensoniqplay streamed stereo: sbig.wav (16-bit stereo, 44100 frames/ch at 22050 Hz -- a per-channel pool > 32 KB, so it streams) plays as true stereo under the sound IRQ.  The file de-interleaves into left/right halves of one mm_alloc pool; oscillator 0 plays the left double-buffer on DOC channel 0, oscillator 1 the right on channel 1, and a silent timer (osc 2) drives refills of BOTH per fire.  'streaming stereo' proves the two-voice path; 'finished after 1' (~120 ticks; 44100/22050 = 2.0 s) proves both voices clocked the whole file.  L/R separation confirmed by capturing MAME per-channel audio (left continuous on output ch1, right on ch2).
